Package com.smartlostfound.view

Class ItemTableModel

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.table.AbstractTableModel
com.smartlostfound.view.ItemTableModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TableModel
public class ItemTableModel extends AbstractTableModel
Custom table model providing structured tabular data of Item records for the dashboard JTable. Supports polymorphic property rendering and fast row lookups.
